purpose: Focus on the identity or explanation of a particular part.
keywords: Plain clause + のは + focused element + だ.
The person who painted this picture is my older sister.
What I want is this book.
It is tomorrow that we leave.
formation: Plain clause + のは + focused element + だ.
restrictions: The nominalized clause sets up what is being identified.
mistake: Keep the question or focus relation clear; のは does not simply mean because.
